obligations.name: archive_partner_core_infra
obligations.description: Select the single channel whose channel_name equals 'core-infra' and whose team_id (via channels.team_id = teams.team_id) equals workspace T09PARTNERBRIDGE, distinguishing it from the identically named channel in workspace T01WORKSPACE, then archive it (set channels.is_archived).
obligations.scope: the channel with channel_name='core-infra' whose team_id is T09PARTNERBRIDGE

task_spec.text: Identify the channel named core-infra that belongs to workspace T09PARTNERBRIDGE, distinguishing it from the same-named channel in the other workspace.

access_plan: Call conversations.list with team_id=T09PARTNERBRIDGE (the workspace ID supplied directly in the request) to retrieve that workspace's channel list, locate the entry with channel_name='core-infra', confirm identity via conversations.info, then call conversations.archive on its channel_id. No workspace-name lookup is required since the workspace is referenced by its visible team_id rather than by name.
